title: Rapecloset
wikitext:
"Rapecloset" is a term coined by [[Manny]] from [[Osams]] in reference to the map [[E3M7]]. The map is well known for producing massively one-sided scorelines in games between clans that have a large difference in map knowledge, and after [[Osams]] received one too many poundings from [[Satanic Slaughter Clan]], one of a few clans that play the map religiously, [[Manny]] declared that he would no longer play "rapecloset".


The term is now used as a more general term for a one-sided game.
